The exact ReadytoCook state is bound, and the supplied closed action inventory contains no action or lifecycle carrier attached to it. The dossier does not provide an exact alternative carrier, so the missing represented behavior establishes the issue.
decisions.violated_obligation: ReadytoCook must display and update the cooking time.

decisions.basis: Pair-0005 NL8 endpoint dossier and exact closed transition inventory.
decisions.reason: The contract requires the DoorShut Cancel self-transition. Exact source and target identity are supplied, and the closed inventory shows DoorShut -> DoorOpen but no DoorShut -> DoorShut edge. The body annotation cannot rebut the exact executable endpoint requirement.
decisions.violated_obligation: DoorShut must have a Cancel-triggered self-transition.

decisions.basis: Pair-0005 NL1 group dossier and exact event/transition inventory.
decisions.reason: The contract requires Cancel and door-opened alternatives from DoorShut. Exact facts show only the Door_Opened consumer leading to DoorOpen; there is no Cancel consumer or self-edge. The source annotation is not an executable trigger-bearing transition and therefore cannot rebut the missing alternative.
decisions.violated_obligation: DoorShut must provide both the Cancel self alternative and the door-opened DoorOpen alternative.

decisions.basis: Pair-0005 NL2 trigger dossier and exact DoorShut-to-DoorOpen transition facts.
decisions.reason: The contract requires the DoorShut-to-DoorOpen transition to be triggered by the quoted phrase 'Door Opened'. The endpoint binds exactly and the closed model has the corresponding transition, but the supplied semantic mapping does not uniquely decide whether the source action wording and the closed event identity are equivalent. Both a satisfied trigger reading and a non-equivalent trigger reading remain compatible.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The closed trigger Door_Opened may be the intended semantic equivalent of the source phrase 'Door Opened action'.
decisions.violated_obligation: The DoorShut-to-DoorOpen transition must be triggered by Door Opened.

decisions.basis: Pair-0005 NL2 trigger dossier and exact DoorOpen-to-DoorShut transition facts.
decisions.reason: The contract requires the DoorOpen-to-DoorShut transition on door closed. The endpoint binds exactly, while the supplied mapping does not uniquely equate the natural-language trigger phrase with the closed event identity Close_Door. A satisfying event-equivalence reading and a trigger mismatch reading remain possible.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The closed event Close_Door may be the intended semantic realization of the source phrase 'door closed'.
decisions.violated_obligation: The DoorOpen-to-DoorShut transition must be triggered by door closed.

decisions.basis: Pair-0005 NL3 trigger dossier and protected nested-route facts.
decisions.reason: The contract requires placing an item to trigger the DoorOpen-to-DoorOpenWithItem behavior. The exact states bind, but the supplied facts say the behavior is realized through nested compiler-owned route segments and do not expose a complete event-specific author-level join. Direct trigger absence and equivalent nested-route realization remain compatible.
decisions.strongest_defeater: The item-placement behavior may be carried by the supplied nested compiler-owned route segments rather than a single direct transition.
decisions.violated_obligation: Placing an item in the microwave must trigger the DoorOpen-to-DoorOpenWithItem transition.

result.reason: All 25 required obligation IDs were assessed exactly once. Precise closed endpoint absences and explicit missing action facts are established where the supplied inventories decide them; macro-boundary and event-equivalence cases remain unresolved with typed undercutting readings when the dossier supports competing interpretations.

issues.basis: NL1 endpoint contract; exact source transition tr_0001; closed transition inventory lines 56-57; source trace identity mapping.
issues.expected: A transition with source DoorShut and target DoorShut exists in the microwave scope.
issues.observed: The complete closed transition inventory contains DoorShut -> DoorOpen on transition:line:57, but no DoorShut -> DoorShut transition.
issues.reason: The source explicitly requires the DoorShut self-transition, while the closed inventory has no edge with that exact endpoint pair. The source body also contains the Cancel text, but it is not a closed transition endpoint.
issues.requirement_quote: From this state, the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source body records Cancel on DoorShut, but the closed model has no corresponding self-transition, so that text does not establish the required executable edge.
issues.title: Missing DoorShut Cancel self-transition

issues.basis: NL1 transition group; exact source alternatives tr_0001 and tr_0002; closed event-consumer and transition inventories.
issues.expected: The DoorShut alternatives include a Cancel-triggered DoorShut self-transition and a door-opened transition to DoorOpen.
issues.observed: The closed model exposes only the DoorShut-to-DoorOpen transition with trigger Door_Opened; no closed consumer or transition realizes the Cancel-triggered self alternative.
issues.reason: The shared-source relation requires two alternatives, but the closed model realizes only the door-opened branch. The missing branch is a precise group-level trigger-set gap beyond the endpoint candidate.
issues.requirement_quote: From this state, the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed or transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The DoorShut state text contains Cancel, but no executable closed transition consumes Cancel from DoorShut.
issues.title: DoorShut alternatives omit the Cancel branch

issues.expected: ReadytoCook displays and updates the cooking time.
issues.observed: The closed model has no action inventory or state lifecycle action attached to ReadytoCook; the exact closed state exists but carries no represented action.
issues.reason: The state behavior is explicitly required by NL5 and source body provenance, but the closed model contains no action carrier for it. The frozen S4 predicate cannot be used because the contract does not provide an exact lifecycle phase.

issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model may encode the behavior outside the supplied action representation, but no such carrier is present in the closed artifact.

issues.basis: NL1 requires DoorShut to remain in DoorShut on Cancel; exact source inventory identifies source transition tr_0001, while closed transition inventory contains no DoorShut-to-DoorShut edge. The existing DoorShut and DoorOpen state refs bind the absent-edge comparison.
issues.expected: A transition from DoorShut to DoorShut for the Cancel action.
issues.observed: The closed model has state:DoorShut:line:50 -> state:DoorOpen:line:51 on transition:line:57 and no DoorShut-to-DoorShut transition.
issues.reason: The exact closed model has DoorShut -> DoorOpen on Door_Opened but no DoorShut -> DoorShut transition. The source-side Cancel behavior is represented only by source body provenance and is absent from the closed transition endpoint inventory.
issues.requirement_quote: From this state, the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source transition is represented by a body annotation rather than an explicit PlantUML edge, but the NL separately requires the Cancel self-transition; no closed endpoint realizes it.

issues.basis: NL1 transition group requires Cancel and door-opened alternatives from DoorShut. Closed event-consumer facts show Door_Opened consumed by transition:line:57, while no Cancel consumer exists for DoorShut and no DoorShut self-edge exists.
issues.expected: DoorShut alternatives selected by Cancel and door opened, targeting DoorShut and DoorOpen respectively.
issues.observed: Only the DoorShut-to-DoorOpen alternative is present and reachable on Door_Opened; the Cancel alternative has no closed-model consumer or endpoint.
issues.reason: The required DoorShut alternatives are not operationally complete in the closed model: the DoorOpen alternative exists, but the Cancel alternative is missing. The exact source and target group is clear.
issues.requirement_quote: From this state, the system can either remain in DoorShut if a Cancel action is performed or transition to the DoorOpen state when the door is opened.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source body annotation may encode Cancel behavior outside an explicit edge, but no trigger-bearing closed transition or endpoint establishes the required Cancel alternative.
issues.title: Incomplete DoorShut transition alternatives

issues.basis: The closed model binds DoorShut and DoorOpen exactly and provides transition:line:57 with trigger Door_Opened; the source transition tr_0002 maps to that relation.
issues.expected: DoorShut to DoorOpen on door opened.
issues.observed: Reachable closed transition:line:57 realizes DoorShut -> DoorOpen on Door_Opened.
issues.reason: The exact closed model contains the required DoorShut-to-DoorOpen edge with the corresponding reachable event consumer, so this endpoint is not a violation. This contract is therefore omitted from candidates and unresolved.

issues.strongest_rebuttal: None; the exact closed endpoint and event consumer are present.
